name.description:
The name of the category, such as "givenName".

@see #names

country.description: The country code for which this data is representative.

values.description:
The values for this category and country, ordered from most to least common (by population). Thus selecting from
these values with early weighting will produce more realistic distributions.

title:
This type provides realistic sets of data that can be used to fill out information about people and places for
testing and demonstration purposes. The values are always sorted from most to least common, so selecting from
these values with early weighting will produce more realistic distributions; see {@link Array#sample}.

There are various categories available, such as:
 - given names
 - surnames
 - country sub-divisions (states/provinces)

```py
for i in range(10):
    print(c3.SampleData.Demographic.forNameCountry('surname', 'CN').values.sample()[0] + \
          c3.SampleData.Demographic.forNameCountry('givenName', 'CN').values.sample()[0])
```

```js
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  console.log(SampleData.Demographic.forNameCountry('surname', 'CN').values.sample()[0] +
              SampleData.Demographic.forNameCountry('givenName', 'CN').values.sample()[0])
}
```
